get_font_path: get the font path for OCR recognition rendering using default or language-specific settings
get_font_path_langs: get a language-specific font path when a single language is provided in the langs list
get_font_path_download: auto-download a missing font file from the configured remote URL base path
get_font_path_default: get the default recognition render font path from settings.RECOGNITION_RENDER_FONTS all key
get_font_path_directory: create the parent directory for a font file if it does not already exist
